rv.q: "Little about the show’s psychology feels likely or lived in, which makes it difficult to access the work emotionally, despite some simple, lovely melodies from Kander and their mournful, reed-heavy orchestrations...The director, Liesl Tommy, and the scenic designer, Clint Ramos, make one terrific choice, setting the whole of the show in...

“An affecting coming-of-age tale…A show whose moods are sometimes uncertain and even jarring…The story holds together thanks in large part to the fluid staging of Liesl Tommy and a top-notch nine-person cast…Truly elevating the entire proceedings is Kander’s music.
